newsitem.title: USA: Richey to buy Simmonds unit control.
newsitem.headline: Richey to buy Simmonds unit control.

text.p: Richey Electronics Inc said it signed a letter to purchase from Simmonds Capital Ltd 81 percent of the common stock of Simmonds' electronic component distribution unit, Simmonds Technologies Inc.

Simmonds Technology is a Canada-wide distributor of interconnect, electromechanical and passive electronic components, headquartered in Toronto, with additional branch locations in the Halifax, Montreal, Ottawa, Winnipeg, Saskatoon, Calgary, Edmonton, and Vancouver regions. In 1996, it had sales of approximately C$42 million.
Pending certain conditions, the transaction is expected to close within 45 days.
